notes.title: Join our discord server!
notes.content:
We are working really hard to make a game that everyone will enjoy! Here, at MJStudio, we value our community's ideas & opinions, and that's why we decided to create this discord server!

In this server you can:

[list]
[*] Give us suggestions on what you would want to see in the game or how to improve the game
[*] Be part of the testers that will be able to test this game before it comes out
[*] Become a mod & hype the community
[*] Get a chance to win a game key in the giveaways
[*] Chat with the developers & the community
[*] Be advised of the game updates & events
[*] [b]And more![/b]
[/list]

There is [b]no[/b] reasons to [b]Not[/b] join our discord!

*[u]discord server[/u] : https://discord.gg/C7wDmC5vGB
